title: Gabriel Ramírez-Vilchis
text:
About Me
I am an undergraduate student in Genomic Sciences at the National Autonomous University of Mexico (UNAM).
My main interests include:

Immunology and host–virus interactions

Erythropoiesis and red blood cell development

Neuroscience, particularly neurodevelopment and neurodegenerative diseases

Bioinformatics & Genomics, especially RNA-seq and machine learning applications in biology

I am guided by humanity, responsability and accountability. I combine my background in biology with bioinformatics skills to understand biological phenomena and address questions about life from different perspectives. I am also developing skills in project and business management, with the goal of connecting scientific knowledge with real-world applications in biotechnology.
My commitment is to contribute to impactful research by turning scientific questions into meaningful insights and solutions.
